# Vendored libraries

Served from the site itself rather than a CDN, so the page has no third-party script dependencies.

| File | Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `three.module.min.js` | [three.js](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) | r169 (0.169.0) | MIT |
| `lenis.mjs` | [Lenis](https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis) | 1.1.13 | MIT |

To update, replace the file with the same build from npm and bump the version here.
